messages:
iris: Incident pager triggered — spike in customer error reports + quality alerts for /generate endpoint, starting ~08:02 UTC. Auto-routing moved ~45% traffic to cheap-quantized variant 'gptx-lite-q4' and we are seeing hallucination/regression signals. Paging oncall.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: #oncall-eng (primary: dan) — SmartRouting anomaly detected: cost-route deviation to variant 'gptx-lite-q4' above policy thresholds. Severity: high. Link: https://console.redwood/internal/incidents/2351239999
dan: @iris I’m on it. Pulling logs. Can someone post sample bad outputs? /cc @maya
maya: Pasting a couple of customer snippets we received via CS:
> "The summary invents facts about the company — references product features that don't exist."
> "Answer includes confident but wrong phone numbers."
maya: Quick check of eval hooks shows BLEU/ROUGE-ish metric drop and increased rejection rate for the last 30m.
senthil: Querying routing decisions now. `SELECT variant, count(*) FROM routing_events WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour' GROUP BY variant;` — early result: gptx-lite-q4 = 46%, gptx-std = 40%, gptx-robust = 14%.
ops-bot: Recent config change detected: policy-optimizer v2.7 deployed 08:01 UTC — changed cost weights for 'family=gptx' variants. Deploy author: @eva. Rollback tag available: v2.6
eva: I pushed a weight tweak this morning to reduce spend on high-seq jobs. Didn’t expect it to affect mapping to q4 variant. rolling back now.
dan: While rollback happens, we should stop routing to gptx-lite-q4 immediately. Can someone push an emergency blacklist for that variant?
iris: Command to apply emergency block:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/routing/override \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"action":"blacklist_variant","variant":"gptx-lite-q4","expires":"30m","reason":"emergency-quality-block"}'
```
maya: Blacklist applied, confirmed by control-plane: status=active, effected_traffic_drop=~44%.
senthil: Routing traffic shifted back to gptx-std/gptx-robust. Latency and token-cost trending up slightly but quality signals improving.
cs-bot: We’ve informed top 5 impacted customers and opened support tickets (CS-3245, CS-3246). Customers reported degraded summaries and one FSD regression causing customer-facing page to show wrong feature names.
dan: Running live sampling of 500 requests through gptx-std vs gptx-lite-q4 for A/B diffs. Early diffs show hallucination rate: lite-q4=12%, std=2% for prompts set A.
iris: Agreed to keep blacklist for 30m, then do a controlled canary with 1% traffic to lite-q4 behind extra eval hooks.
eva: Rolling back policy-optimizer v2.7 now. `deploy rollback policy-optimizer v2.6 --confirm`
ops-bot: Rollback complete at 08:16 UTC. Confirmed policy weights restored.
dan: After rollback, routing distribution: gptx-std 62%, gptx-robust 28%, gptx-lite-q4 10% (stale sessions). Monitoring quality metrics.
maya: Aggregated metric: user-reported incidents per 1k requests fell from 8.2 -> 1.1 within 12 minutes of blacklist + rollback. Sending a short summary to SLO board.
senthil: Root cause hypothesis: optimizer v2.7 introduced an unintended mapping rule for 'family=gptx' when seq_length_estimate > 512 — it favored the cheapest quantized variant due to a missing quality penalty. I'm pulling the PR diff.
eva: Found the offending diff: missing term `+ quality_penalty` in cost_score calculation. PR #9123. I’ll open a patch and add tests.
iris: Short-term actions:
- Keep variant blacklist until we confirm stable (ops has it) — owner: dan
- Rollback confirmed — owner: eva
- CS notify cadence + customer remediation docs — owner: maya
- Patch optimizer to add quality penalty + unit tests — owner: senthil
- Postmortem + timeline draft by EOD — owner: iris
dan: Also recommending an emergency routing policy: never route >20% of traffic to variants without recent eval pass in last 24h. Filing a config change request.
maya: CS notes: most impacted customers are on certain region-eu nodes that had bursty traffic and long seq-length prompts.
senthil: Added integration test to simulate high seq_length scenarios. Running CI now.
ops-bot: Canary note: will allow 1% traffic to lite-q4 at 08:45 UTC for 30m if canary checks pass (no regressions). Manual approval required.
iris: Action items updated in incident tracker: https://console.redwood/incidents/2351239999/actions
cs-bot: Customer-facing apology draft prepared and sent to legal for review. ETA 2h.
eva: Patch merged to main to restore quality penalty and added guardrails. Deploying to staging.
dan: After rollback and blacklist, we saw latency steady and cost delta acceptable for now — will monitor overnight. Reassigning oncall to night-shift.
iris: Handoff to night oncall (maya) at 08:40 UTC. Please escalate if regression reappears or blacklist expires without controlled canary.
maya: Copy. I’ll watch alerts and coordinate with dan if needed.
iris: Postmortem checklist: timeline, root cause, detection, mitigation, customer impact (est. 27 customers impacted, 3 had moderately critical user-facing issues), codeowner PRs, follow-ups. Targeting full postmortem by tomorrow 18:00 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident 2351239999 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to SEV-2. Updates: rollback + variant-blacklist applied. Next update scheduled in 2h or on significant change.
iris: Thanks team. Good quick work on the blacklist and rollback. We'll reconvene for the writeup. :thumbsup:
